responses: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. The patient notes the bowel movements are urgent, occasionally accompanied by mucus discharge, and often followed by a feeling of incomplete evacuation. She went camping several months ago and recalls another member of the camping party falling ill recently.
Past medical history: No notable past medical history provided. Social history: No pertinent social history related to symptoms.
Denies any recent weight change, fever, nausea, or vomiting. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Migraine and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
